title: FNAF OC Ideas: Original Character Prompts (Unofficial)
summary: Original FNAF-inspired OC prompts with soft-horror and mystery packs. Unofficial fan content only.
body_markdown:
> **Unofficial fan content.** This page is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Scott Cawthon, Steel Wool Studios, or any official Five Nights at Freddy's rights holders. Five Nights at Freddy's and related names are trademarks of their owners. We discuss **original characters** inspired by the vibe of horror-animatronic stories—never official assets, and we make no trademark claims.


> **Quick answer:** Mix a role, a malfunction, and a soft human detail to invent a FNAF-inspired original character. These prompts are starting sparks—not official lore.

Table of Contents


Toggle


##


How to use a prompt


#


- Pick one line.
- Rename everything so it is original.
- Add one rule for after midnight.
- Fill the[FNAF OC template](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/fnaf-oc-template) .


##


Prompt lists


#


###


Security and night staff


#


- Rookie guard who alphabetizes incident reports to stay calm
- Supervisor who hears music through walls and pretends not to
- Intern with a flashlight that only works when they tell the truth


###


Workshop and parts


#


- Tech who gives broken parts nicknames
- Painter who only finishes left eyes
- Inventory clerk counting suits that move between counts


###


Performers (original designs)


#


- Daytime mascot who hates applause but loves quiet rehearsals
- Backup dancer animatronic who learns guests' birthdays
- Stagehand puppet convinced the curtains are a shoreline


###


Strange but gentle


#


- Lost birthday kid who leaves polite notes, never pranks
- Vending machine spirit that trades soda for secrets
- Clock in the hallway that apologizes when it runs fast


###


Cast seeds (build 3 OCs together)


#


- Mentor, apprentice, and the thing in the vents they both ignore
- Rival techs sharing one toolbox
- Night crew who run a secret book club in the break room


##


Turn idea → design


#


- One signature shape (ears, hat, crack pattern)
- Palette of 3–5 colors
- Voice note (soft, glitchy, formal)
- Relationship to one other OC


When the sheet feels alive, play them somewhere unofficial and fun—see[FNAF roleplay game](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/fnaf-roleplay-game) .


##


More prompts


#


###


Soft horror (playable with friends)


#


- Janitor who leaves polite sticky notes for monsters
- Lost-and-found clerk who returns hope, not just hats
- Night DJ for an empty food court


###


Mystery-forward


#


- Guard who sketches footprints before cleaning them
- Intern mapping drafts that should not exist
- Photographer whose flash only works on secrets


##


Avoid these traps


#


- Clone names with one letter changed
- Lore essays longer than the character
- Power sets with no weakness
- "Evil for no reason" with no soft spot


##


Keep notes outside the app


#


Whatever tool you try, keep a short external note with the character or pet name, the goal for this week, and three facts that must not drift. Apps change. Your notes travel.

##


Prompt remix method


#


Take any prompt and change: location (kitchen → roof), time (night → rainy morning), and soft spot (cats → crossword puzzles). You now have a new OC without new lore dumps.
